- Added channel notifications for linked boards.
- Added a new multi-person property to easily set multiple assignees or owners on a card.

- fix issue with search on multi-select property value
- fix issue with cursor when editing comment

- fix postgres migration issue
- fix error exporting to CSV

- fix exception checking non-members

[Changes from 7.4.0-7.4.2](https://github.com/mattermost/focalboard/compare/v7.4.0...v7.4.2)
